# 基础法案

## capabilityDomain: app-shell-ui

### [LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-003-V2] 全仓退役施工图物理清除

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "**/*"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "app-shell-ui",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：Legacy APP user-demand startup blueprint exists after App Shell production entry.",
    "不得发生：Retired, archived, deprecated, hidden, or copied variants of the legacy APP user-demand startup blueprint remain in the repository.",
    "不得发生：App source, package scripts, migration docs, or non-governance docs still reference the deleted legacy APP user-demand startup blueprint."
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-003-V2",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：After App Shell becomes the production UI entry, the orphan legacy APP user-demand startup blueprint must be physically absent. Retired, archived, deprecated, or copied variants of that legacy authority are forbidden.",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-APP-SHELL-UI-003-V1",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: code-purity

### [LAW-CODE-PURITY-001-V3] 代码纯洁度与僵尸零容忍

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "package.json",
    "scripts/**",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "code-purity",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency",
    "static.config",
    "static.json",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [
    "scripts/acceptance/fixtures/**",
    "scripts/audit/generated/**",
    "src/plugins/xuanxue-ai-production/generated/**"
  ],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：活动源码文件超过 500 个物理行，或函数超过 75 行、7 个参数、8 个返回分支、5 层嵌套、16 圈复杂度或10个 await。",
    "不得发生：God file、God function、混合 Owner、混合运行角色、无 Owner 文件或以 utils/helpers/common/shared/service/manager/facade/bridge/adapter 隐藏职责。",
    "不得发生：zombie 文件、zombie 导出、孤立顶层声明、死导出 helper 链、死内部声明岛、字面量或常量折叠后的死分支。",
    "不得发生：未证明最终消费者的 re-export、namespace、registry、object bag、handler map 或 zombie-to-zombie 链被当作活性证据。",
    "不得发生：动态 import 非字面量、未解析、未由 Owner 明示，或副作用 import 充当隐藏 keepalive。",
    "不得发生：import、re-export、dynamic import 或 side-effect import 以不同语法绕过同一 Owner 边界。",
    "不得发生：能力域导入 plugin、plugin 导入能力私有 runtime、mediator 执行浏览器动作或 child ability 隐藏多步业务流。",
    "不得发生：any、ts-ignore、ts-nocheck、catch-and-swallow、伪成功或 mock/demo/placeholder/no-op/fallback 生产路径。",
    "不得发生：export star、无合法工具要求的 default export、require、超过 28 个 import declaration、24 个 import source 或24个命名导出。",
    "不得发生：以 bridge、compatibility、legacy、shadow、fallback、planner、workflow 或同义路径名称隐藏第二 Owner、第二执行真相或通用编排器。",
    "不得发生：generated artifact 被手工维护为源真相，或注释掉的可执行代码代替物理删除。",
    "不得发生：一个 plugin 或 job flow 承担多个业务需求、演变为通用 workflow engine，或共享能力吸收业务流程。",
    "不得发生：public export、registry entry、handler、report/schema field、wrapper 或抽象层不能证明活动消费者，或修复只做改名、转发、搬家和重新包装而未物理删除、内联、合并或简化真实结构。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-CODE-PURITY-001-V3",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使每个活动源码文件证明唯一 Owner、单一角色和真实活性，并以 AST、类型、symbol graph、模块图及反规避检查对结构红线、Owner 边界、类型逃逸、伪运行和全部 zombie surface 实行零容忍二元执法。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-CODE-PURITY-001-V2",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```
